firm_data.firm_description: Simonetti & Associates is a family law firm that provides services in family law, adoption, and alimony. They have been awarded Long Island's Best Divorce Lawyer ten years in a row.
notable_facts: Voted Best Divorce Firm On Long Island Ten Years in a Row
Attorneys have more than 75 years of combined experience.

email.subject: AI for Simonetti & Associates, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Louis,

Ten years running as Long Island's Best Divorce Firm speaks to the precision your team brings to family law. With three attorneys handling complex cases across divorce, adoption, and custody matters, you're competing on skill and reputation, not headcount.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to the Northeast. I'd be happy to stop by your Westbury office to share how ex-lawyers built this specifically for firms like Simonetti & Associates.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
